title: The Ordinary will close on Black Friday to prioritise blood donations over ‘hyperconsumerism’
summary: The Estée Lauder companies-owned skin care brand is hosting The Ordinary Blood Drive in the US and Canada on Black Friday (27 November) to encourage donations and ‘expand access to this life-saving resource’, with complementary initiatives taking place in the UK and Denmark
